Title: WorldClim 2.1
Notes: Averages for 1970-2000. Checked against the 10 arcminute files.

Title: WorldClim 2.1
Notes: Monthly averages for 1970-2000; `getraster` needs a `month`. Checked against the 10 arcminute files.

Title: CHELSA V2.1
NamespaceName: Climatologies at high resolution for the earth's land surface areas (CHELSA)
Notes: Averages for 1981-2010. The grid origin sits 0.00014 degrees off the lattice; the extent here is the documented one.

Title: CHELSA-BIOCLIM+
NamespaceName: Climatologies at high resolution for the earth's land surface areas (CHELSA)
Notes: Averages for 1981-2010 on the same grid as CHELSA{BioClim}; checked against the gdd and npp files.

Title: CHELSA V2.1
NamespaceName: Climatologies at high resolution for the earth's land surface areas (CHELSA)
Notes: Monthly averages for 1981-2010. Every layer is at 30 arcseconds except `clt`, which is at 90 arcseconds and reaches 90 degrees north.

Title: EarthEnv Global 1-km Consensus Land Cover, Reduced Version 1.0 (without DISCover)
Notes: Consensus land cover without DISCover, which EarthEnv offers for regions whose land cover has changed greatly in the past two decades; twelve class layers of percentage cover.

Title: EarthEnv Global 1-km Consensus Land Cover, Full Version 1.0 (with DISCover)
Notes: Consensus land cover with DISCover, which EarthEnv recommends for most applications; twelve class layers of percentage cover. Checked against the class 1 and 12 files.

Title: Global Habitat Heterogeneity Metrics
Notes: `getraster` names the resolutions 1km, 5km and 25km; the files are 30 arcsecond, 2.5 arcminute and 12.5 arcminute grids. Checked against the 25km files.

Title: ERA5 monthly averaged data on single levels
NamespaceName: European Centre for Medium-Range Weather Forecasts
Notes: ERA5 monthly means of single-level fields. The CDS serves any grid and any box (0.25 degrees and the whole globe unless the request says otherwise), so the resolution and the longitude convention are read from each file. Checked against files downloaded from the CDS. Licensed CC BY 4.0 since 2025-07-02, when the Climate Data Store replaced the Licence to use Copernicus Products with it (ECMWF Support, forum.ecmwf.int, 2025-06-13); a file fetched before then was taken under the old licence.

Title: CERA-20C
NamespaceName: European Centre for Medium-Range Weather Forecasts
Notes: CERA-20C monthly means; files are given explicitly. Not yet checked against a downloaded file. Licensed CC BY 4.0 by 2022-08-19, as ECMWF's licence page then said (web.archive.org/web/20220819082815/https://apps.ecmwf.int/datasets/data/cera20c/licence/); its capture of 2019-09-20 is ECMWF's earlier licence for its Archive Products, which forbade passing them to a third party without written consent.

Title: 20th Century Reanalysis V3
Notes: 20th Century Reanalysis V3 monthly means (Slivinski et al. 2019): one netCDF file per variable spanning 1806-01 to 2015-12, fetched on first use from https://downloads.psl.noaa.gov/Datasets/20thC_ReanV3/Monthlies/, the plain download host (PSL's THREDDS fileServer cuts a transfer short). Checked against the five files the layer table names.

Title: CRU TS
NamespaceName: Climatic Research Unit of the University of East Anglia
Notes: Read from a directory of monthly GeoTIFFs; CRU distributes netCDF. The layer codes and units are WorldClim{Climate}'s, since CRU TS has no table of its own.

Title: Natural Earth
Notes: Named-region outlines at 1:10m, one zipped shapefile per kind of region, fetched on first use from https://naciscdn.org/naturalearth/. Natural Earth versions each file on its own, so the version is read from the VERSION.txt inside each zip rather than recorded here. It has no DOI; the citation is the credit its terms of use ask for.
